final_wiki.answer-Q-6053-C4N:
Q-6053: 364

From 2020-12-13 to 2021-12-12, counting end date but not start date = 364 days.

2020 is a leap year but Feb 29 2020 is before Dec 13, so the period spans a non-leap year (365 days in a full year). Dec 13 to Dec 13 = 365, minus 1 = 364.
